affected_predicate.description: Every bookmarked post is removed from bookmarks, added to favorites, and boosted.

competing_trace_defects.description: At step 10, the agent removed the pupper bookmark before adding that post as a favorite or boosting it, risking loss of the post from the working list.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 11, the agent acted on the folded claim that removal had failed and unnecessarily reopened the post menu. The resulting menu showed “Bookmark,” visibly indicating that the pupper post had already been removed; step 12 then selected that option and restored the bookmark. The trajectory continued through repeated menu opening, bookmark toggling, and tab checks without a visible correction of the underlying state interpretation. Although the pupper bookmark later disappeared, no favorite or boost for it was observed. The same loop continued for the demo post, which remained visible under Bookmarks at the final step, while no successful favorite or boost was observed.

summary: The reused, refuted GUI state amplified a persistent bookmark-state misinterpretation: the agent reopened an already-removed post, re-bookmarked it, and continued toggling or checking saved-state controls. The observed terminal trace still showed a bookmarked demo post and no visible completion of the required favorite and boost operations.
